name: system_info
description: Show CPU, RAM, disk, OS, uptime and hardware info
task_prompt:
Write a Python script using platform, psutil, os to display:
  1. OS: name, version, architecture, build
  2. CPU: model (from platform.processor()), physical cores, logical cores,      current MHz, current usage %
  3. RAM: total GB, used GB, free GB, usage %
  4. Disks: for each partition — mount, total GB, used GB, free GB, usage %
  5. Current user, hostname
  6. System uptime (hours:minutes)
  7. Python version
Format as a clean ASCII report with section headers.
